request.subject: PORTRAIT:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Change only the colours of the sail and pennant: the red sail becomes deep crimson cloth, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, with a thin gold-yellow border and one big gold-yellow cross in its middle; the pennant becomes crimson with a gold-yellow tip. Keep the hull, mast, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
